props.__desc__suffix: ; Only applies when a Menu is used (see 'breakpoint')

persistent.desc: Allows the popup to not be dismissed by a click/tap outside of it or by hitting the ESC key; Also, an app route change won't dismiss it

no-esc-dismiss.desc: User cannot dismiss the popup by hitting ESC key; No need to set it if 'persistent' prop is also set

no-route-dismiss.desc: Changing route app won't dismiss the popup; No need to set it if 'persistent' prop is also set

auto-close.desc: Any click/tap inside of the popup will close it

square.desc: Forces content to have squared borders

no-refocus.desc: (Accessibility) When the popup gets hidden, do not refocus on the DOM element that previously had focus

no-focus.desc: (Accessibility) When the popup gets shown, do not switch focus on it

transition-show.desc: One of Quasar's embedded transitions; When a Menu is used it defaults to 'fade'; When a Dialog is used the default depends on 'position' (see 'breakpoint')

transition-hide.desc: One of Quasar's embedded transitions; When a Menu is used it defaults to 'fade'; When a Dialog is used the default depends on 'position' (see 'breakpoint')

escape-key.desc: Emitted when ESC key is pressed; Does not get emitted if the popup is 'persistent' or it has 'no-esc-dismiss' set

props.__desc__suffix: ; Only applies when a Dialog is used (see 'breakpoint')

events.__desc__suffix: ; Only applies when a Dialog is used (see 'breakpoint')

model-value.desc: Defines the state of the component (shown/hidden); Either use this property (along with a listener for 'update:modelValue' event) OR use v-model directive

breakpoint.desc: Breakpoint (in pixels) of window width/height (whichever is smaller) from where a Menu will get to be used instead of a Dialog

currentComponent.desc: Access current underlying component (QMenu or QDialog)

ref.desc: The actual component (QMenu or QDialog); Access it directly, without '.value'
